simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עַכְבָּר (H5909) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עַכְבָּר (ʻakbâr) means a mouse (as nibbling ) First listed occurrence: 1Sam 6 4.

definitions.full: H5909. akbar עַכְבָּר noun masculine 1Sam 6:4 mouse (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic עַכְבְּרָא ; Syriac (in Lexicons) , (PS 22 ); Arabic plural mares murum Frey (Kam), compare also Hom As 338 ; Arabic of jerboa RS K 302 ; see Tristr NHB 122 FFP 10ff. ); — absolute ׳הָע unclean Lev 11:29 (H), Isa 66:17 (compare RS Sem i. 275, 2nd ed. 293 ); plural construct (ה)זָהָב עַכְבְּרֵי 1Sam 6:4 , 11 , 18 ; suffix עַכְבְּרֵיכֶם צַלְמֵי 6:5 .
definitions.rootNote: probably from the same as 5908 in the secondary sense of attacking ;
